rule: dev-bother-me-nope's hook and helper scripts run under the system python3 (3.9 on macOS): keep them and their tests 3.9-safe (no sys.stdlib_module_names, match, X|Y types) and run the suite under /usr/bin/python3 too.
why: test_script_imports_stdlib_only used sys.stdlib_module_names (3.10+); coders gated only on uv's 3.13, so TEST1 failed 2 tests on /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 (R1-4).

rule: Code that removes a git worktree first checks git status --porcelain --ignored (and rebase/bisect state) and keeps any worktree holding ignored files outside known caches: git worktree remove silently deletes ignored files like .env.
why: The cleanup helper decided 'clean' without --ignored and deleted a worktree's .env (R1-1 HIGH); the FIX's hand-run cleaner path used plain git worktree remove and brought the loss back (R2-1 HIGH).

rule: When a fix changes what a helper script does, grep SKILL.md and references/briefs.md for the same git commands and route every path through the helper (add a flag if needed); never re-implement the helper's guarded steps in prose.
why: FIX1 removed repo-wide worktree prune and added ignored-file checks in the helper, but the cleaner text still prunes (R2-3) and its new local-only path re-implemented removal without the checks (R2-1).

rule: Test every deploy-guard.py rule behind wrappers that take options or values (timeout -k 5 60, sudo -u x, sh -ec, xargs --replace, fish --command=) and with the approval prefix; list forms it can't parse in deploy-guards.md's blind spots.
why: Squash merges passed the guard behind timeout/sudo/sh -ec (R1-5); after the fix xargs --replace and fish --command= still passed (R2-5) and the approval prefix lifted the protected-branch delete block (R2-4).

rule: A value two dev-bother-me-nope scripts must agree on (protected branch names, cache dirs) lives in one shared module, or a test asserts the copies are equal; never type it by hand in both.
why: The cleanup helper protected dev/develop/staging but deploy-guard.py did not, so push --delete dev passed (R1-6); after the fix both lists were still hand-typed with no test (R2-6).
